channel.title: The Global Meridian – International News Wire
channel.description: Authoritative, verified global journalism from international news bureaus across Geneva, Tokyo, Washington, London, New Delhi, and Dhaka.

item.title: UN Security Council and Global Envoys Finalize Historic Middle East Peace and Reconstruction Accord in Geneva
item.description: Multilateral peace negotiators in Geneva approve comprehensive reconstruction framework backed by $65 billion humanitarian stabilization pledges.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: Open Sovereign AI Charter Ratified by 40 Nations: Global Coalition Mandates Transparent Scientific Neural Architecture
item.description: International scientific consortium in Tokyo and Berlin adopts open-weights verification protocol to ensure frontier artificial intelligence models serve public welfare.
item.author: m.vance@meridian-news.org (Marcus Vance)

item.title: South Asian Tri-Nation Clean Energy Corridor Finalizes $15B Cross-Border Power Interconnection
item.description: Ministers from Dhaka, Kathmandu, and Thimphu ink historic multilateral grid pact channeling 12,000 megawatts of Himalayan hydropower to coastal manufacturing centers.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: James Webb Observatory and Lunar Polar Station Confirm Extensive Subsurface Water-Ice Basins on the Moon
item.description: Spectroscopic mapping from orbital and surface rovers pinpoints millions of metric tons of accessible ice in permanently shadowed craters.
item.author: j.moreau@meridian-news.org (Julian Moreau)
